[service: https://scottishdentalcare.co.uk/anti-snoring-treatments] Anti-Snoring Treatments ENQUIRE HERE Patient Experiences Fitted for an anti-snoring device (Somnowell mandibular advancement) to be worn at night. Philip was knowledgeable and very helpful and the device works extremely well; it's not cheap but I'm waking much less often at night and napping less through the day and my partner says that she's having the best sleep she's had in 30 years! Alasdair We can help you overcome snoring issues. Oral devices are acknowledged by experts to be one of the most effective treatments for snoring. At Scottish Dental Care we work with a fantastic range of premium anti snoring devices that are bespoke, discreet, hygienic and most importantly, effective. If you suffer from snoring, TMJ, or bruxism, our range of anti-snoring devices could be the answer. ENQUIRE HERE How much will it cost? Anti-snoring devices range from £795 to £2,400 including scans, fit and the device itself. Our Treatment Coordinators will be happy to discuss your specific requirements and guideline fees. We can also explain more about how it works, options that may be suitable for you and answer any questions.
